params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repo=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'; Write-Output ('HOST=' + $env:COMPUTERNAME); Write-Output ('REPO=' + $repo); git -C $repo fetch --prune origin; git -C $repo status --short --branch; git -C $repo rev-parse origin/main; git -C $repo branch -r
